verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH terminal client, and terminal products can plausibly ship AI agents, so this axis applies. Its only AI-related evidence is a feature that converts a plain-language description into a single shell command (termius-docs-6). That could in principle produce one-off git commands, but nothing shows a conversational agent that operates on a repository. Missing for 10: a multi-step conversational agent, repository browsing/search, file editing by an agent, agent-driven commit/pull/push workflows, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
